definitions.ask: Should the successor picker footer also advertise the new ^N / ^P keys?
definitions.why: Footer already has 6-7 chips and never showed ↑/↓; other Bob pickers already teach Ctrl+N/P

choices.label: Footer stays exactly as today; Ctrl+N/P work but stay unadvertised, like ↑/↓ already are
Every footer variant gains a `^N ^P move` chip after Tab; one more chip in a long footer
